# Repository Consolidation Release v1.2

**Project:** W.I.N.G. — Workflows, Intelligence, Next-Generation Governance  
**Release date:** 7 September 2026  
**Base repository snapshot:** `8d582e6a1729d82777bbdbdfbc3a35890e020d8c`  
**Release boundary:** Fictional and synthetic portfolio evidence; no production-effectiveness, legal-compliance, conformity, certification or independent-assurance claim

## Release outcome

This release consolidates the DuckTalent AIMS improvement-cycle package into the repository's authoritative risk, control, evidence, traceability and thematic AIMS records. It also adds automated reproducibility checks and corrects reviewer navigation.

## Material changes

- Added `EV-AI005-015` through `EV-AI005-021` to the canonical evidence index.
- Linked `IAF-2026-001`, `RCA-2026-001`, `CAPA-2026-001`, `CER-2026-001`, `MR-2026-001` and `FCR-2026-001` across the risk, control, evidence, crosswalk and AIMS records.
- Recognized one complete bounded synthetic finding-to-closure cycle for AIMS themes M16–M18.
- Preserved DuckTalent's Critical risk and **DO NOT DEPLOY** gate; no production risk-reduction credit was added.
- Updated the master crosswalk to 34 evidence records and the current corrective-action decision chain.
- Added GitHub Actions checks for the DuckTalent fairness control, PondGPT authorization control, DuckTalent change monitor and DuckTalent corrective-action effectiveness gate.
- Refreshed repository and folder navigation, authoritative-version labels and the visuals index.

## Validation criteria

The release is acceptable when all four executable evidence tests and their semantic outcome assertions pass, repository-relative links resolve, the workbook renders without formula errors, and all v1.2 documents preserve the stated portfolio boundary.
